afterimage.name: AfterImage
afterimage.description: Enables player afterimage effects. The character's frames are stored in a history buffer, and are displayed after a delay as afterimages.

afterimagetime.name: AfterImageTime
afterimagetime.description:
Changes the duration of the player's afterimage effects, if currently enabled. If no afterimage effects are being displayed, this controller does nothing.
Known bugs: If the timegap parameter in the originating AfterImage controller is not set at 1, using this AfterImageTime will cause the frame positions to be reset.

allpalfx.name: AllPalFX
allpalfx.description: Same as PalFX, except that this affects the palette of the background and lifebars as well as the palette of all characters and explods (regardless of the ownpal parameter). See the PalFX section for details on the parameters to AllPalFX.

add.syntax: add = add_r, add_g, add_b (int, int, int)

mul.syntax: mul = mul_r, mul_g, mul_b (int, int, int)

sinadd.syntax: sinadd = ampl_r, ampl_g, ampl_b, period (int, int, int, int)

angleadd.name: AngleAdd
angleadd.description: Adds to the drawing rotation angle used by AngleDraw.

angledraw.name: AngleDraw
angledraw.description: Draws the player (for 1 frame) rotated about his axis by the angle set by the AngleSet controller. When facing right, a positive angle means a counterclockwise rotation.

anglemul.name: AngleMul
anglemul.description: Multiplies the drawing rotation angle used by AngleDraw by the specified factor.

angleset.name: AngleSet
angleset.description: Sets the drawing rotation angle used by AngleDraw. The angle is initialized at 0.

appendtoclipboard.name: AppendToClipboard
appendtoclipboard.description: This is the same as DisplayToClipboard, except that message text is added on a new line, instead of overwriting whatever text is already on the clipboard. See DisplayToClipboard for a format description.

assertspecial.name: AssertSpecial
assertspecial.description: This controller allows you to assert up to three special flags simultaneously. MUGEN will automatically "deassert" each flag at every game tick, so you must assert a flag for each tick that you want it to be active.

attackdist.name: AttackDist
attackdist.description:
Changes the value of the guard.dist parameter for the player's current HitDef. The guard.dist is the x-distance from P1 in which P2 will go
into a guard state if P2 is holding the direction away from P1.
The effect of guard.dist only takes effect when P1 has movetype = A.

attackmulset.name: AttackMulSet
attackmulset.description: Sets the player's attack multiplier. All damage the player gives is scaled by this amount.

bgpalfx.name: BGPalFX
bgpalfx.description: Same as PalFX, except that this affects the palette of the background and lifebars instead of the palette of the character. See the PalFX section for details on the parameters to BGPalFX.

add.syntax: add = add_r, add_g, add_b (int, int, int)

mul.syntax: mul = mul_r, mul_g, mul_b (int, int, int)

sinadd.syntax: sinadd = ampl_r, ampl_g, ampl_b, period (int, int, int, int)

bindtoparent.name: BindToParent
bindtoparent.description: If the player is a helper, binds the player to a specified position relative to its parent. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing.

bindtoroot.name: BindToRoot
bindtoroot.description: If the player is a helper, binds the player to a specified position relative to its root. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing.

bindtotarget.name: BindToTarget
bindtotarget.description: Binds the player to a specified position relative to the specified target.

changeanim.name: ChangeAnim
changeanim.description: Changes the action number of the player's animation.

changeanim2.name: ChangeAnim2
changeanim2.description: Like ChangeAnim, except this controller should be used if you have placed P2 in a custom state via a hit and wish to change P2's animation to one specified in P1's air file. For example, when making throws, use this to change P2 to a being-thrown animation.

changestate.name: ChangeState
changestate.description: Changes the state number of the player.

clearclipboard.name: ClearClipboard
clearclipboard.description: Erases any text currently on the player's clipboard.

defencemulset.name: DefenceMulSet
defencemulset.description: Sets the player's defense multiplier. All damage the player takes is scaled by this amount.

destroyself.name: DestroySelf
destroyself.description: If called by a helper-type character, DestroySelf causes that character to be removed from the field of play. DestroySelf is not valid for non-helper characters.

displaytoclipboard.name: DisplayToClipboard
displaytoclipboard.description: This controller is only useful for debugging. DisplayToClipboard clears the player clipboard and prints a specified message to it. Display of the player clipboards is enabled in debug mode (press Ctrl+D).

params.syntax: params = exp_1, exp_2, exp_3, exp_4, exp_5, exp_6

envcolor.name: EnvColor
envcolor.description: Turns the whole screen a solid color, excepting foreground-layer animations like hit sparks and "ontop" explods. Foreground layers of the stage will not be visible.

envshake.name: EnvShake
envshake.description: Causes the screen to shake vertically.

explod.name: Explod
explod.description: The Explod controller is a flexible tool for displaying animations such as sparks, dust and other visual effects. Its functionality includes that of GameMakeAnim, which is now deprecated.

shadow.syntax: shadow = shad_r, shad_g, shad_b (int, int, int)

explodbindtime.name: ExplodBindTime
explodbindtime.description: Changes the position binding time of the player's explods.

forcefeedback.name: ForceFeedback
forcefeedback.description: Creates force feedback for supported force feedback devices. This controller is not implemented in MUGEN 1.0.

freq.syntax: freq = start (integer constant), d1, d2, d3 (float constants)

ampl.syntax: ampl = start (integer constant), d1, d2, d3 (float constants)

fallenvshake.name: FallEnvShake
fallenvshake.description: Shakes the screen using the fall.envshake parameters set by an attack (see HitDef controller). This controller is effective only if GetHitVar(fall.envshake.time) is not zero, and it sets GetHitVar(fall.envshake.time) to zero after being executed. This controller is used in common1.cns to shake the screen when a player falls, and is not normally useful otherwise.

gamemakeanim.name: GameMakeAnim
gamemakeanim.description: Creates a game animation, like a hit spark or a super charging effect. This controller has been superseded by Explod and is now considered deprecated. Support for it may be removed in future versions.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.description: Accelerates the player downwards, using the value of the player's "yaccel" constant.

helper.name: Helper
helper.description: Creates another instance of the player as a helper character.

hitadd.name: HitAdd
hitadd.description: Adds to the current combo counter.

hitby.name: HitBy
hitby.description: Temporarily specifies the types of hits that are be allowed hit to the player.

hitdef.name: HitDef
hitdef.description:
Defines a single hit of the player's attack. If the player's Clsn1 box (red) comes in contact with his opponent's Clsn2 box (blue), and the HitDef was define on or before that particular point in time, then the specified effect will be applied. This is one of the more complex, but most commonly-used controllers.
A single HitDef is valid only for a single hit. To make a move hit several times, you must trigger more than one HitDef during the attack.

palfx.mul.syntax: palfx.mul = r1, g1, b1 (int, int, int)

palfx.add.syntax: palfx.add = r2, g2, b2 (int, int, int)

hitfalldamage.name: HitFallDamage
hitfalldamage.description:
When the player has been hit and is in a falling state, apply damage
from the fall (specified in the hitdef) to the player.

hitfallset.name: HitFallSet
hitfallset.description: When the player has been hit, sets the player's fall variables.

hitfallvel.name: HitFallVel
hitfallvel.description: If the player has been hit and is in a falling state, sets the player's velocities to the fall velocities (fall.xvel and fall.yvel) specified in the HitDef.

hitoverride.name: HitOverride
hitoverride.description: Defines a hit override. If the player is hit by an attack of the specified type, he will go to the specified state number instead of his default gethit behavior. Up to 8 hit overrides can be active at one time.

lifeadd.name: LifeAdd
lifeadd.description: Adds the specified amount to the player's life, scaled by the player's defense multiplier if necessary.

lifeset.name: LifeSet
lifeset.description: Sets the player's life to the specified value.

makedust.name: MakeDust
makedust.description: This controller is deprecated; use the Explod controller.

modifyexplod.name: ModifyExplod
modifyexplod.description:
Modifies the parameters of an existing Explod. Syntax is basically
the same as Explod. However, this controller is subject to future
change. Any code relying on this controller is not guaranteed to
work in the future.

movehitreset.name: MoveHitReset
movehitreset.description: Resets the movehit flag to 0. That is, after executing MoveHitReset, the triggers MoveContact, MoveGuarded, and MoveHit will all return 0.

nothitby.name: NotHitBy
nothitby.description: Temporarily specifies types of hits that are not allowed to hit the player.

null.name: Null
null.description: Does nothing. May be used for temporarily disabling other state controllers by simply changing their type to Null.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Changes the player's display offset. The player is drawn shifted from his axis by this amount.

palfx.name: PalFX
palfx.description: Applies temporary effects the player's palette. These will also affect the palette of any explods and helpers the player owns, unless they have specified ownpal = 1.

add.syntax: add = add_r, add_g, add_b (int, int, int)

mul.syntax: mul = mul_r, mul_g, mul_b (int, int, int)

sinadd.syntax: sinadd = ampl_r, ampl_g, ampl_b, period (int, int, int, int)

parentvaradd.name: ParentVarAdd
parentvaradd.description: If the player is a helper, adds to one of the player's parent's working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be added to by this controller. If the player is not a helper, this controller does nothing.

parentvarset.name: ParentVarSet
parentvarset.description: If the player is a helper, sets one of the parent's working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be set by this controller. Does nothing if the player is not a helper.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pauses the game for the specified amount of time. Player and background updates are not carried out during this time.

playerpush.name: PlayerPush
playerpush.description: Disables the player's push checking for one tick. Push checking keeps players from overlapping one another. By temporarily disabling push checking, dodge-type moves in which the player passes through another (but can still be hit) can be implemented.

posadd.name: PosAdd
posadd.description:
Offsets the player's position by the specified amounts. The X coordinate is relative to the player's axis, with positive values moving in the direction that the player is facing. The Y coordinate
is relative to the player's axis, with negative values moving up.

posset.name: PosSet
posset.description: Sets the player's position to the specified coordinates. The X coordinate is relative to the center of the screen, with positive values moving right. The Y coordinate is relative to the floor, with negative values moving up.

poweradd.name: PowerAdd
poweradd.description: Adds the specified amount to the player's power.

powerset.name: PowerSet
powerset.description: Sets the amount of power that the player has.

projectile.name: Projectile
projectile.description: Creates a projectile for the player. The Projectile controller takes all the parameters of the HitDef controller, which control the HitDef for the projectile. In addition, Projectile has the following additional parameters:

projshadow.syntax: projshadow = shad_r, shad_g, shad_b (int, int, int)

palfx.mul.syntax: palfx.mul = r1, g1, b1 (int, int, int)

palfx.add.syntax: palfx.add = r2, g2, b2 (int, int, int)

remappal.name: RemapPal
remappal.description: Changes one of the player's palettes to another.

removeexplod.name: RemoveExplod
removeexplod.description: Removes all of a player's explods, or just the explods with a specified ID number.

reversaldef.name: ReversalDef
reversaldef.description: Defines a reversal. If one of P2's Clns1 boxes comes in contact with one of P1's Clsn1 boxes and a ReversalDef is active, then P1 will reverse P2's attack. Use with p1stateno (and optionally p2stateno) for creating reversal attacks.

palfx.mul.syntax: palfx.mul = r1, g1, b1 (int, int, int)

palfx.add.syntax: palfx.add = r2, g2, b2 (int, int, int)

screenbound.name: ScreenBound
screenbound.description: Specifies whether or not the player's movement should be constrained to the screen or not. Also determines whether the camera should move to follow the player or not. The results of this controller are valid for 1 tick.

selfstate.name: SelfState
selfstate.description: Like ChangeState, except that this changes a player back to a state in his own state data. Use this when you have placed an opponent player in a custom state via an attack, and wish to restore the opponent to his own states.

sprpriority.name: SprPriority
sprpriority.description: Changes the player's sprite priority. Higher-priority sprites are drawn on top of lower-priority sprites.

statetypeset.name: StateTypeSet
statetypeset.description: Changes the current state type and move type. Useful for states that go from the ground into the air, etc.

sndpan.name: SndPan
sndpan.description: Changes the panning of a currently playing sound. This controller may be continually triggered to smoothly move a sound across the sound field or to have a sound follow the player.

stopsnd.name: StopSnd
stopsnd.description: Stops any sound which is playing on the specified channel.

superpause.name: SuperPause
superpause.description: Freezes the gameplay and darkens the screen. While each player is frozen, no time passes for them. Use for a dramatic pause during the start of hyper attacks.

targetbind.name: TargetBind
targetbind.description: Binds the player's specified targets to a specified location relative to the player's axis.

targetdrop.name: TargetDrop
targetdrop.description: Drops all targets from the player's target list, except possibly for those having a specified target ID number. Useful for applying effects to only certain targets.

targetfacing.name: TargetFacing
targetfacing.description: Turns all targets to face a specified direction relative to the player.

targetlifeadd.name: TargetLifeAdd
targetlifeadd.description: Adds the specified amount to all targets' life, scaled by the targets' defense multipliers if necessary.

targetpoweradd.name: TargetPowerAdd
targetpoweradd.description: Adds the specified amount to all targets' power.

targetstate.name: TargetState
targetstate.description: Makes all targets change to the specified state number.

targetveladd.name: TargetVelAdd
targetveladd.description: Adds the specified amounts to all targets' velocities. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the target is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.

targetvelset.name: TargetVelSet
targetvelset.description: Sets all targets' velocities to the specified values. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.

trans.name: Trans
trans.description: Overrides the player's animation transparency parameters for current game tick. Useful for special effects.

turn.name: Turn
turn.description: Instantly turns the player to face the opposite direction. Does not play a turning animation.

varadd.name: VarAdd
varadd.description: Adds to one of the player's working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be added to by this controller.

varrandom.name: VarRandom
varrandom.description: Sets the specified int variable to a random value. Float variables cannot be set by this controller.

varrangeset.name: VarRangeSet
varrangeset.description: Sets a contiguous range of the player's working variables to the same value. Either float variables or int variables can be set by this controller, but not both at the same time.

varset.name: VarSet
varset.description: Sets one of the player's working variables. Either a float variable or an int variable can be set by this controller, but not both at the same time.

veladd.name: VelAdd
veladd.description: Adds the specified amounts to the player's velocity. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.

velmul.name: VelMul
velmul.description: Multiplies the player's velocity by the specified amounts. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.

velset.name: VelSet
velset.description: Sets the player's velocity to the specified values. A positive x velocity is in the direction that the player is facing, while a positive y velocity is downward on the screen.

victoryquote.name: VictoryQuote
victoryquote.description: Selects a victory quote from the player to display in the next victory screen.

width.name: Width
width.description: Temporarily changes the size of the player's width bar for 1 tick. Useful for controlling the "pushing" behavior when the player makes contact with another or with the sides of the screen.

abs.name: Abs
abs.description: Computes the absolute value of its argument.

acos.name: Acos
acos.description: Computes the arccosine (in radians) of the specified argument.

ailevel.name: AILevel
ailevel.description: Returns the difficulty level of the player's AI.

alive.name: Alive
alive.description: Returns 1 if the player is still able to fight, 0 if the player has been KOed.

anim.name: Anim
anim.description: Returns the current animation action number of the player.

animelem.name: AnimElem
animelem.description:
Gets the animation-time elapsed since the start of a specified element of the current animation action. Useful for synchronizing events to elements of an animation action.
(reminder: first element of an action is element 1, not 0)

animelemno.name: AnimElemNo
animelemno.description:
Returns the number of the animation element in the current action
that would be displayed at the specified time. The argument to AnimElemNo represents the time to check, expressed in game ticks, relative to the present.

animelemtime.name: AnimElemTime
animelemtime.description:
Gets the animation-time elapsed since the start of a specified element of the current animation action. Useful for synchronizing events to elements of an animation action.
(reminder: first element of an action is element 1, not 0)

animexist.name: AnimExist
animexist.description:
Returns 1 if the specified animation action exists for the player.
The result of this trigger is undefined if the player has been placed in a custom state by a successful hit. In this situation, use SelfAnimExist.

animtime.name: AnimTime
animtime.description:
Gives the difference between the looptime of the current animation action and the player's animation-time. Useful for knowing when the end of the animation has been reached. (Animation-time is the time in game-ticks that the player has spent within the current animation action.)
The name may be confusing. Try to think of it as "time from the end of the animation". During the animation, AnimTime will always return a non-positive number.

asin.name: Asin
asin.description: Computes the arcsine (in radians) of the specified argument.

atan.name: Atan
atan.description: Computes the arctangent (in radians) of the specified argument.

authorname.name: AuthorName
authorname.description: Returns the player's author's name (specified in the .DEF file). This may also be useful for telling apart characters with the same name but different authors.

backedgebodydist.name: BackEdgeBodyDist
backedgebodydist.description: BackEdgeBodyDist gives the distance from the back of the player, as determined by the end of his width bar, to the back edge of the screen.

backedgedist.name: BackEdgeDist
backedgedist.description: BackEdgeDist gives the distance between the x-axis of the player and the edge of the screen behind of the player.

canrecover.name: CanRecover
canrecover.description: If the player is currently in a falling state, returns 1 if he is currently able to recover, and 0 if he is not currently able to recover. If the player is not currently falling, the output of this trigger is undefined.

ceil.name: Ceil
ceil.description: Implements the "ceiling" function. Returns the least integer which is greater than or equal to the specified argument.

command.name: Command
command.description: Triggers if the user has input the specified command.

cond.name: Cond
cond.description:
This trigger takes three arguments. The first argument is a condition argument.
If the condition is true (i.e., nonzero), Cond evaluates and returns the second
argument. If the condition is false, Cond evaluates and returns the third
argument. If the condition is bottom, then Cond returns bottom without
evaluating the second or third arguments.

const.name: Const
const.description: Returns the value of one of the player's constants.

const240p.name: Const240p
const240p.description:
Converts a value from the 240p coordinate space to the player's coordinate space.
The conversion ratio between coordinate spaces is the ratio of their widths.

const480p.name: Const480p
const480p.description:
Converts a value from the 480p coordinate space to the player's coordinate space.
The conversion ratio between coordinate spaces is the ratio of their widths.

const720p.name: Const720p
const720p.description:
Converts a value from the 720p coordinate space to the player's coordinate space.
The conversion ratio between coordinate spaces is the ratio of their widths.

cos.name: Cos
cos.description: Computes the cosine of the specified argument (in radians.)

ctrl.name: Ctrl
ctrl.description: Returns the control flag of p1.

drawgame.name: DrawGame
drawgame.description: Returns 1 if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has ended the round in a draw, 0 otherwise.

draw.name: Draw
draw.description: Returns 1 if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has ended the round in a draw, 0 otherwise.

exp.name: Exp
exp.description:
Computes the exponential of the argument (e raised to the power of
the argument.) This produces slightly more accurate results than the
equivalent expression e**(argument).

facing.name: Facing
facing.description: Returns 1 if the player is facing to the right, and -1 if the player is facing to the left.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Implements the floor function. Returns the greatest integer less than or equal to its argument.

frontedgebodydist.name: FrontEdgeBodyDist
frontedgebodydist.description: FrontEdgeBodyDist gives the distance between the front of the player (as determined by the front edge of his width bar) and the edge of the screen.

frontedgedist.name: FrontEdgeDist
frontedgedist.description: FrontEdgeDist gives the distance between the x-axis of the player and the edge of the screen in front of the player.

fvar.name: FVar
fvar.description: This trigger takes a mandatory variable number as an argument. It returns the value of the player's specified float variable.

gameheight.name: GameHeight
gameheight.description:
Returns the height of the game space in the player's local coordinate space.
The game space is defined as a spatial mapping to the visible area of the screen
in which players interact.  Intuitively, it can be thought of as encompassing the
graphical area of the game.
The dimensions of the game space is specified by the GameWidth and GameHeight
parameters in mugen.cfg.

gametime.name: GameTime
gametime.description: Returns the total number of ticks that have elapsed in the game so far.

gamewidth.name: GameWidth
gamewidth.description:
Returns the width of the game space in the player's local coordinate space.
The game space is defined as a spatial mapping to the visible area of the screen
in which players interact.  Intuitively, it can be thought of as encompassing the
graphical area of the game.
The dimensions of the game space is specified by the GameWidth and GameHeight
parameters in mugen.cfg.

gethitvar.name: GetHitVar
gethitvar.description: When the player is in a gethit state, returns the value of the specified hit parameter.

hitcount.name: HitCount
hitcount.description: Returns the number times the player's current attack move has hit one or more opponents. This value is valid only for a single state; after any state change, it resets to 0. To prevent it from resetting to 0, set hitcountpersist in the StateDef (see cns documentation for details). The HitCount and UniqHitCount triggers differ only when the player is hitting more than one opponent. In the case where the player is hitting two opponents with the same attack, HitCount will increase by 1 for every hit, while UniqHitCount increases by 2.

hitdefattr.name: HitDefAttr
hitdefattr.description:
Checks the attribute parameter of the player's currently-active HitDef.
If the player is not currently attacking, then no parameters will match.
Can be used for simple move-interrupts from weaker to stronger attacks in the CMD file.

hitfall.name: HitFall
hitfall.description: If the player is currently in a gethit state, returns the fall flag of the hit. The output of this trigger is undefined if the player is not in a gethit state. For an explanation of the fall flag, see the HitDef documentation.

hitover.name: HitOver
hitover.description: If the player is in a gethit state, returns 1 when the hittime has expired, and 0 otherwise. For an explanation of hittime, see the HitDef documentation.

hitpausetime.name: HitPauseTime
hitpausetime.description: Returns the time until the player's hitpause expires. The player enters a hitpause when his attack comes in contact with an opponent. The initial hitpause time is equal to the first value of the pausetime parameter in the player's HitDef. If ignorehitpause is not set, this will always return 0.

hitshakeover.name: HitShakeOver
hitshakeover.description: If the player is in a gethit state, returns 1 if the hit shake (the period when he is shaking in place) has ended, and 0 otherwise.

hitvel.name: HitVel
hitvel.description:
Gets the value of the velocity imparted to the player by a hit.
You must specify the component that you want to check, eg.
"HitVel Y" to check the vertical velocity component.

id.name: ID
id.description: Returns the ID number of the player. The ID number is unique for every player throughout the course of a match. Any helper that is created during this time will also receive its own unique ID number. This trigger may be useful for getting opponents' ID numbers, to be later used with the "playerID" redirection keyword (see exp docs). Do not confuse playerID with targetID.

ifelse.name: IfElse
ifelse.description:
This trigger takes three arguments. If the first is nonzero, IfElse returns the
value of the second argument. Else, it returns the value of the third argument.
All arguments are evaluated prior to execution of IfElse. In particular, any
side effects caused by evaluation of the arguments (such as variable
assignment, or performing a computation that generates a warning) will occur.
If you wish to avoid these side effects, then use Cond.

inguarddist.name: InGuardDist
inguarddist.description: Returns 1 if the player is within guarding distance of an opponent's physical or projectile attack. The guarding distance is the value of the guard.dist parameter of the opponent's HitDef. Returns 0 if out of guard distance, or the opponent is not attacking.

ishelper.name: IsHelper
ishelper.description: This trigger takes an optional ID number as an argument. If the ID number is omitted, IsHelper returns 1 if the player is a helper character, and 0 otherwise. If the ID number is included, then IsHelper returns 1 if the player is a helper character with the specified ID number, and 0 otherwise.

ishometeam.name: IsHomeTeam
ishometeam.description: Returns 1 if the player's team is considered the "home team". In arcade modes, the computer is always considered the home team. In versus modes, P1's side (left) is the home team.

lifemax.name: LifeMax
lifemax.description: Returns the maximum amount of life the player can have. This is normally the value of the "life" parameter in the [Data] group of the player variables, but may be different in situations such as team modes.

ln.name: Ln
ln.description: Returns the natural logarithm of its argument. This produces slightly more accurate results than the otherwise equivalent expression log(e,(argument)).

log.name: Log
log.description: Takes two arguments a and b, and returns the base-a logarithm of b.

lose.name: Lose
lose.description: Returns 1 if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has lost the round, 0 otherwise. Can be suffixed with "KO" or "Time" to return 1 only when the round has been lost by a KO or by time expiring, respectively.

loseko.name: LoseKO
loseko.description: Returns 1 if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has lost the round, 0 otherwise. Can be suffixed with "KO" or "Time" to return 1 only when the round has been lost by a KO or by time expiring, respectively.

losetime.name: LoseTime
losetime.description: Returns 1 if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has lost the round, 0 otherwise. Can be suffixed with "KO" or "Time" to return 1 only when the round has been lost by a KO or by time expiring, respectively.

matchover.name: MatchOver
matchover.description: Returns 1 if the match has ended. (For example, in the case of a best-of-three match, this will return true when one of the players or teams has won two rounds.)

movecontact.name: MoveContact
movecontact.description:
This trigger is valid only when the player is in an attack state.
MoveContact gives a non-zero value if P2 has either been hit, or has guarded P1's attack. It gives 0 otherwise. P1 is the player, and P2 is his opponent.
Typically used with the "StateNo" and "Command" triggers for detecting move-interrupts in the CMD file.

moveguarded.name: MoveGuarded
moveguarded.description:
This trigger is valid only when the player is in an attack state.
MoveGuarded gives a non-zero value if P2 is guarding, or has guarded, P1's attack. It gives 0 otherwise. P1 is the player, and P2 is his opponent.
Typically used with the "StateNo" and "Command" triggers for detecting move-interrupts in the CMD file.

movehit.name: MoveHit
movehit.description:
This trigger is valid only when the player is in an attack state.
MoveHit gives a non-zero value if P2 has been hit by P1's attack. It gives 0 otherwise.
Typically used with the "StateNo" and "Command" triggers for detecting move-interrupts in the CMD file.

movetype.name: MoveType
movetype.description:
MoveType gives the player's move-type. Refer to the section
on StateDef in the CNS documentation for more details on MoveType.
Useful for "move interrupts" in the CMD file.

movereversed.name: MoveReversed
movereversed.description:
This trigger is valid only when the player is in an attack state.
MoveReversed gives a non-zero value if P1's attack has been reversed by P2. It gives 0 otherwise.

name.name: Name
name.description: Returns the player's name (the internal name specified in the .DEF file, which may not be the same as the displayed name).

numenemy.name: NumEnemy
numenemy.description: NumEnemy returns the number of opponents that exist. Neutral players and normal helpers are not considered opponents.

numexplod.name: NumExplod
numexplod.description: This trigger takes an ID number as an optional argument. If the ID number is omitted, NumExplod returns the number of explods owned by the player. If the ID number is included, then NumExplod returns the number of explods with that ID number that are owned by the player. The ID number must be greater than -1. An ID number of -1 or less will give the same behavior as if the ID number is omitted.

numhelper.name: NumHelper
numhelper.description:
This trigger takes an ID number as an optional argument. If the ID number is omitted, then NumHelper returns the total number of helpers currently owned by the player. If the ID number is included, then NumHelper returns the total number of helpers with that ID number owned by the player. The ID number must be greater than 0. If the ID
number is 0 or less, then all helpers are counted.

numpartner.name: NumPartner
numpartner.description: NumPartner returns the number of partners that exist. Neutral players and normal helpers are not considered partners.

numproj.name: NumProj
numproj.description: Returns the total number of projectiles currently owned by the player.

numprojid.name: NumProjID
numprojid.description: This trigger takes an ID number as a required argument. It returns the number of projectiles currently owned by the player and having the specified ID number.

numtarget.name: NumTarget
numtarget.description: This trigger takes an ID number as an optional argument. If the ID number is omitted, NumTarget returns the current number of targets for the player. If the ID number is included, then NumTarget returns the number of targets for the player which have that target ID number. The ID number must be greater than -1. An ID number of -1 or less will give the same behavior as if the ID number is omitted.

p1name.name: P1Name
p1name.description: This is an alias for the Name trigger. See "Name".

p2bodydist.name: P2BodyDist
p2bodydist.description: Returns the distance of P2 from P1, where P1 is the player, and P2 is his opponent. P2BodyDist is useful in the CMD for cases where P1 has an attack that is different when performed close to P2.

p2dist.name: P2Dist
p2dist.description: Returns the distance of P2 from P1, where P1 is the player, and P2 is his opponent.

p2life.name: P2Life
p2life.description: Same as Life, except that this returns the opponent's life.

p2movetype.name: P2MoveType
p2movetype.description: Same as MoveType, except that this returns the opponent's movetype.

p2name.name: P2Name
p2name.description: Same as P1Name, except that this returns the name of the primary opponent (the opponent in versus mode, or the first opponent in team mode).

p2stateno.name: P2StateNo
p2stateno.description: Same as StateNo, except that this returns the opponent's state number.

p2statetype.name: P2StateType
p2statetype.description: Same as StateType, except that this returns the opponent's state type.

p3name.name: P3Name
p3name.description: Same as P1Name, except that this returns the name of the player's teammate, if present.

p4name.name: P4Name
p4name.description: Same as P1Name, except that this returns the name of the secondary opponent, if present.

palno.name: PalNo
palno.description: Returns the palette number of the player (i.e., the color scheme chosen for the character during character select.)

parentdist.name: ParentDist
parentdist.description:
This trigger is only valid for helper-type characters.
ParentDist returns the distance from the helper to its parent. It works similarly to P2Dist.

pi.name: Pi
pi.description: This trigger returns the numeric value of pi (3.141593...)

pos.name: Pos
pos.description: Gets the value of the player's position. You must specify the component that you want to check, eg. "Pos Y" to check the Y-position.

power.name: Power
power.description: Returns the amount of power the player has.

powermax.name: PowerMax
powermax.description: Returns the maximum amount of power the player can have. This is normally 3000 (level 3).

playeridexist.name: PlayerIDExist
playeridexist.description: Returns 1 if a player with the specified ID number exists, 0 otherwise. This ID number is obtained using the "ID" trigger (see ID). Do not confuse PlayerID with TargetID.

prevstateno.name: PrevStateNo
prevstateno.description: Returns the number of the state that the player was last in. The results of this trigger are not guaranteed to be accurate.

stateno.name: StateNo
stateno.description: Returns the player's current state number. Useful for "move interrupts" in the CMD file.

projcanceltime.name: ProjCancelTime
projcanceltime.description: This trigger takes an required nonnegative ID number as an argument.  If the player's last projectile to make any kind of contact was cancelled by an opponent's projectile and had the specified ID number, then ProjCancelTime returns the number of ticks since that contact occurred. If the specified ID number is 0, then the projectile ID is not checked. If no projectile meets all the above conditions, then ProjCancelTime returns -1.

projcontact.name: ProjContact
projcontact.description: This trigger takes an optional ID number as a suffix. If the ID number is omitted, ProjContact returns true if any of the player's projectiles either successfully hit the opponent or were guarded by the opponent. When the ID number is specified, ProjContact returns true only if any of the player's projectiles with the specified ID number either successfully hit the opponent or was guarded.

projcontacttime.name: ProjContactTime
projcontacttime.description: This trigger takes an required nonnegative ID number as an argument.  If the player's last projectile to make any kind of contact, made contact with the opponent and had the specified ID number, then ProjContactTime returns the number of ticks since that contact occurred. If the specified ID number is 0, then the projectile ID is not checked. If no projectile meets all the above conditions, then ProjContactTime returns -1.

projguarded.name: ProjGuarded
projguarded.description: This trigger takes an optional ID number as a suffix. If the ID number is omitted, ProjGuarded returns true if any of the player's projectiles were guarded by the opponent. When the ID number is specified, ProjGuarded returns true only if one of the player's projectiles with the specified ID number was guarded by the opponent.

projguardedtime.name: ProjGuardedTime
projguardedtime.description: This trigger takes an required nonnegative ID number as an argument.  If the player's last projectile to make any kind of contact was guarded by the opponent and had the specified ID number, then ProjGuardedTime returns the number of ticks since that contact occurred. If the specified ID number is 0, then the projectile ID is not checked. If no projectile meets all the above conditions, then ProjGuardedTime returns -1.

projhit.name: ProjHit
projhit.description: This trigger takes an optional positive ID number as a suffix. If the ID number is omitted, ProjHit returns true if any of the player's projectiles successfully hit the opponent. When the ID number is specified, ProjHit returns true only if one of the player's projectiles with the specified ID number successfully hit the opponent.

projhittime.name: ProjHitTime
projhittime.description:
This trigger takes an required nonnegative ID number as an argument.  If the player's last projectile to make any kind of contact successfully hit the opponent and had the specified ID number, then ProjHit returns the number of ticks since that contact occurred. If the specified ID number is 0, then the projectile ID is not checked.
If no projectile meets all the above conditions, then ProjHitTime returns -1.

random.name: Random
random.description: Returns a random number between 0 and 999, inclusive.

rootdist.name: RootDist
rootdist.description:
This trigger is only valid for helper-type characters.
RootDist returns the distance from the helper to its root. The root is the main player character who owns the helper: for instance, if you select Kumquat to play with, and Kumquat spawns a helper named Kiwi, who in turn spawns a helper named Penguin, then Penguin's root is Kumquat, and Penguin is a descendant of Kumquat. RootDist works similarly to P2Dist.

roundsexisted.name: RoundsExisted
roundsexisted.description: Returns the number of rounds the player has existed for. On the first round, returns 0. This is useful for a Turns mode intro.

roundstate.name: RoundState
roundstate.description: Returns the current round state number.

screenpos.name: ScreenPos
screenpos.description: Gets the value of the player's absolute (screen-relative) position. You must specify the component that you want to check, eg. "Pos Y" to check the Y-position.

selfanimexist.name: SelfAnimExist
selfanimexist.description: Like AnimExist, except that this only checks P1's animation data. If P1 has been given P2's animation data by a hit, SelfAnimExist will not check P2's animation data to determine whether or not a given action exists.

sin.name: Sin
sin.description: Computes the sine of the specified argument (in radians.)

statetype.name: StateType
statetype.description:
StateType gives the player's state-type. Refer to the section
on StateDef in the CNS documentation for more details on StateType.
Useful for "move interrupts" in the CMD file.

stagevar.name: StageVar
stagevar.description:
Returns information about the stage.
A limited number of parameters are supported.

sysfvar.name: SysFVar
sysfvar.description:
This trigger takes a mandatory variable number as an argument. It returns the value of the player's specified system float variable.
This trigger should NOT be used under normal circumstances. System
variables are reserved for bookkeeping in common1.cns.

sysvar.name: SysVar
sysvar.description:
This trigger takes a mandatory variable number as an argument. It returns the value of the player's specified system int variable.
This trigger is NOT to be used under normal circumstances. System
variables are reserved for bookkeeping in common1.cns.

tan.name: Tan
tan.description: Computes the tangent of the specified argument (in radians.)

teammode.name: TeamMode
teammode.description: TeamMode gives the current mode of play for the player's team.

teamside.name: TeamSide
teamside.description: Returns the team side the player is on. 1 represents P1 side (left), 2 for P2 side (right).

tickspersecond.name: TicksPerSecond
tickspersecond.description: Returns the number of ticks per second. Useful for time calculations.

time.name: Time
time.description: Returns the state-time of the player (that is, the number of ticks that the player has been in the current state so far).

timemod.name: TimeMod
timemod.description: Returns the remainder when the state-time of the player is divided by the specified value.

uniqhitcount.name: UniqHitCount
uniqhitcount.description: Returns the total number of hits the player's current attack move has done. This value is valid only for a single state; after any state change, it resets to 0. To prevent it from resetting to 0, set hitcountpersist in the StateDef (see cns documentation for details). The HitCount and UniqHitCount triggers differ only when the player is hitting more than one opponent. In the case where the player is hitting two opponents with the same attack, HitCount will increase by 1 for every hit, while UniqHitCount increases by 2.

var.name: Var
var.description: This trigger takes a mandatory variable number as an argument. It returns the value of the player's specified int variable.

vel.name: Vel
vel.description: Gets the value of the player's velocity. You must specify the component that you want to check, eg. "Vel Y" to check the Y-velocity.

win.name: Win
win.description: Returns true if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has won the round, false otherwise. Can be suffixed with "KO", "Time", or "Perfect" to return true only when the round has been won by a KO, by time expiring, or with no life lost, respectively.

winko.name: WinKO
winko.description: Returns true if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has won the round, false otherwise. Can be suffixed with "KO", "Time", or "Perfect" to return true only when the round has been won by a KO, by time expiring, or with no life lost, respectively.

wintime.name: WinTime
wintime.description: Returns true if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has won the round, false otherwise. Can be suffixed with "KO", "Time", or "Perfect" to return true only when the round has been won by a KO, by time expiring, or with no life lost, respectively.

winperfect.name: WinPerfect
winperfect.description: Returns true if the player (or the player's team, in team mode) has won the round, false otherwise. Can be suffixed with "KO", "Time", or "Perfect" to return true only when the round has been won by a KO, by time expiring, or with no life lost, respectively.
